7310030.baseName: Habitat Pack of 3 Gold Embroidered Star Hanging Decoration
7310030.variantName: Habitat Pack of 3 Gold Embroidered Star Hanging Decoration
7310030.sourceDescription: Bring celestial charm to your Christmas tree with this pack of 3 embroidered star decorations. Each one is handcrafted from soft felt and embroidered with gold thread, creating a luxe look that lifts your festive display. The white ribbon loop on each star makes hanging simple, whether you're dressing the tree, tying one to a wrapped gift, or adding sparkle to your table setting. The trio gives you flexibility to spread the magic across your home or cluster them together for impact. They're designed for indoor use, so you can enjoy their handcrafted quality throughout the season and beyond. It's an easy way to add warmth and character to your Christmas setup with decorations that feel special from the moment you hang them. . 3 decorations included.; Contains white grossgrain.; Size H10.2, W10.2, D2.5cm.; Made from polyester.; Suitable for indoor usage.

vww7rp6h.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Hinged Christmas Tree Quick Setup - Green - 150 cm
vww7rp6h.sourceDescription: This modern Christmas tree decoration features a unique cone-shaped design, ideal for enhancing the festive atmosphere in any room or outdoor space. Crafted with PVC and PE materials, this piece offers a fade-resistant surface that ensures lasting appeal throughout the season. Premium Materials: Constructed from quality PVC and PE, this decorative item offers a fade-resistant exterior that withstands the test of time, maintaining its vibrant appearance throughout continuous use. Inclusive LED Lighting: Equipped with warm white LED decorative string lights that bring an elegant sparkle to your space. The warm glow offers a cozy, inviting ambiance that transforms any setting into a festive retreat. USB Connectivity: This decoration is powered via USB, offering flexible placement options. Whether it’s next to your indoor sleigh setup or enhancing your garden terrace, it seamlessly plugs into various devices for a hassle-free experience. Modern Aesthetic: With its sleek cone-shaped form and minimalist style, this decoration embodies modern decor principles. It harmonizes with both traditional and contemporary holiday displays. Simple Assembly: Requires assembly by two people, according to the manufacturer’s instructions, ensuring that every piece fits together perfectly and functions as intended. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PE and PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 68 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike tips Hinged Construction for Set up Foldable Stand Number of PE tips: 77 Number of PVC tips: 303 Number of needle tips: 76 Number of pine cones: 40 Number of red berries: 40 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Foldable Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

v0vpzsha.baseName: Dellonda 7ft Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 350 Warm LED Lights - Green
v0vpzsha.variantName: Dellonda 7ft Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 350 Warm LED Lights - Green
v0vpzsha.sourceDescription: This Realistic Dellonda 7ft Christmas Tree is perfect for a little extra glamour. Pre-Lit with 350 warm white LED lights to save the hassle and arguments of untangling the never ending knot of lights! Our Xmas Trees are specially designed to include very realistic pine branches using PE tips. We then use PVC construction for the trunk to make the tree look naturally strong, full and bushy. Our trees are tested to and comply with EN71-2 Flammability Clause 4. This includes the required tests concerning the flammability of a product. Made up of 1,480 PE/PVC branch tips to give a natural and realistic look and feel. Hinged branches make this Christmas tree easy to assemble and store away. Includes strong sturdy metal base, which folds away for easy storage. Tree Width: 43". Suitable for indoor use only! Made from fire retardant materials. • Brand: Dellonda • Colour: Green • Construction: Hinged • Electrical Class: Class II • Metal Stand size: 20" • Nett Weight: 8.60kg • No. of Tips: 1480 • Plug Type: 3-Pin BS • Product Depth (Front to Back): 124.5cm • Product Height (Floor to Top): 210cm • Product Width (Side to Side): 124.5cm • Tip Style: PE/PVC Mix • Tip Width: 5.7cm • Model No. DH82 Refer to instructions. Indoor use only. Warning: keep away from naked flames. Jack Sealey Ltd t/a Dellonda, Kempson Way, Suffolk Business Park, Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk, IP32 7AR UK

vhgqvjbm.baseName: My Christmas Pre-Lit Christmas Garland with LED Lights 2.7m - Gold
vhgqvjbm.variantName: My Christmas Pre-Lit Christmas Garland with LED Lights 2.7m - Gold
vhgqvjbm.sourceDescription: This 2.7 m decorative Christmas garland adds a festive touch to your home with a combination of holly, baubles, flowers and leaves, including glitter-finished details. The integrated LED light string provides an eye-catching glow, while the discreet wire blends with the greenery for a seamless appearance. Made from high-quality plastic with natural-looking stems, the garland is durable, odour-free and resistant to folding. Its flexible design can be twisted and shaped to suit windows, tabletops, staircases, hallways, fireplaces, walls and other decorative spaces. Suitable for Christmas, Valentine's Day and other seasonal displays in homes, gardens, bedrooms, shops, cafés and restaurants. Specifications: 2.7 m decorative Christmas garland, high-quality plastic construction, holly, baubles, flowers and leaf decorations, glitter-finished details, integrated LED light string, discreet matching wire, flexible and shapeable design, odour-free construction, and suitable for indoor and outdoor decorative displays. Dimensions: Length: 270 cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
